title: Workhorse Humanoid Learns Physical Tasks Without Teleoperation or Retargeting
summary:
Researchers have developed a system that allows the G1 humanoid robot to master whole-body movement and manipulation using only human examples. Named Workhorse, the system enables the robot to learn without teleoperation, retargeting, or the use of a robot during the initial data collection phase. In real-time autonomous tests, the G1 robot caught a thrown box, climbed a suitcase, and sorted items using its hands and a kick.

The team tested the robot's durability by attempting to force failures during one-take demonstrations, which the robot navigated autonomously. The research focuses on removing traditional robotic teaching interfaces by allowing humanoids to acquire physical skills directly from human demonstrations.
